We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to produce JSON route with type mol root, children reaction nodes etc. Need to select appropriate templates. We can search for templates matching functional group transformations: likely steps: 1) SN2 to attach side chain? The target has a side chain: Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3 attached to N of triazine? Actually structure: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1. Contains anisole ring with amide linking to a triazine (c2nnn...). The triazine has a substituent Cc3... (benzyl attached to heterocycle). That benzyl has a side chain CN4CC(F)C4 (a fluorinated azetidine? Actually N4CC(F)C4 is a 3-member? It's N4CC(F)C4: a morpholine? It's a N-azetidine with fluorine. So we need retrosynthesis: break amide (retro amide formation via condensation of amine and acid). Break C-N bond between benzyl and triazine (maybe SN2). Break Friedel-Crafts acylation to form anisole ring? Actually anisole ring attached to amide; could be formed via Friedel-Crafts acylation of anisole with acyl chloride derived from triazine carboxylic acid? The forward reaction: Friedel-Crafts acylation attaches acyl group to aromatic ring, breaking halide (acyl chloride). So retro: remove acyl group to give anisole and acyl chloride (or acid). So step1: retrosynthetic disconnection of amide: target -> anisole (COc1cccc(NH) c1?) Actually anisole with amine? The amide bond between anisole amine (anilide) and carbonyl attached to triazine. So retro: break amide to give aniline (COc1cccc(NH2?) Actually the aniline would be COc1cccc(NH2) c1) and carboxylic acid derivative of triazine (c2nnn(... )c2N-COOH). So step1: amide disconnection.

Step2: break C-N bond between benzyl carbon and triazine nitrogen (the substituent Cc3...). That could be SN2 retro (alkyl halide + amine). So we get benzyl halide (e.g., benzyl chloride) and triazine with NH? Actually the triazine currently has N-alkyl substituent (N-CH2-aryl). Retro SN2: break C-N bond to give benzyl halide (e.g., benzyl chloride) and triazine with NH (i.e., N-H). So step2.

Step3: Friedel-Crafts acylation: break bond between anisole ring and carbonyl carbon (acyl group). That would give anisole (methoxybenzene) and acyl chloride derived from triazine carboxylic acid (or acid chloride). So step3.

Thus 3 reactions.

We need template IDs. We don't know IDs; we can search. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria for amide formation (functional_groups_broken: amide? Actually forward reaction: amide formation breaks amine and acid? But we need retrosynthetic template that breaks amide (i.e., forms amide in forward). So functional_groups_formed: amide? In forward, amide formed. So we set functional_groups_formed: "amide". Let's get list of functional groups available.
